steps.title: Filing of Criminal Complaint
steps.description: A criminal complaint is reported to the police regarding an alleged offence under Saudi law.

steps.title: Investigation
steps.description: Police investigate the complaint and collect preliminary evidence before referring the case to the Public Prosecution.

steps.title: Public Prosecution Review
steps.description: Public Prosecution conducts further investigation, interrogates the accused, and determines whether to initiate criminal proceedings.

steps.title: Filing of Charges
steps.description: If sufficient grounds exist, Public Prosecution files charges before the competent Criminal Court.

steps.title: Trial Hearings
steps.description: Criminal Court conducts hearings, examines evidence, and hears submissions from the prosecution and the accused.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment of conviction or acquittal in accordance with applicable law.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under the Law of Criminal Procedure
Appeal on points of law or procedural review as permitted under Saudi law
